rows.question: Describe the following image in detail.
rows.prediction:

A laptop, open and active, sits in front of the person, its screen glowing with the soft light of the screen. The person is holding a pen, perhaps taking notes or working on a document.

To the side of the desk, there's a stack of papers, perhaps related to the work on the laptop. A book lies open, its pages filled with text that the person is reading. A cup, possibly filled with coffee or tea, sits on the desk, adding to the clutter.
